effect.name: GM Edge Luminescence
effect.desc: Sobel-derived luminous edges composited over the original layer.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);float pnkjEdgeLuma(vec2 u){return dot(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u,0.0,1.0)).rgb,L);}void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 p=width/max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);float gx=-pnkjEdgeLuma(u-p)+pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(p.x,-p.y))-2.0*pnkjEdgeLuma(u-vec2(p.x,0.0))+2.0*pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(p.x,0.0))-pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(-p.x,p.y))+pnkjEdgeLuma(u+p);float gy=-pnkjEdgeLuma(u-p)-2.0*pnkjEdgeLuma(u-vec2(0.0,p.y))-pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(p.x,-p.y))+pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(-p.x,p.y))+2.0*pnkjEdgeLuma(u+vec2(0.0,p.y))+pnkjEdgeLuma(u+p);float e=smoothstep(threshold,threshold+0.2,length(vec2(gx,gy)));gl_FragColor=vec4(s.rgb+edgeColor.rgb*e*strength,s.a);}
